notes.title: First update!
notes.content:
Hi, I've made some fixes & cleaned up various things in the game, enjoy!

[i]Summary:[/i]
[list]
[*] Made dogs less rabid on all difficulty settings
[*] Made some gui text more clear
[*] Added signs in hub village (Brannach) so player can see which gate to enter
[*] Updated buttons and GUI background for clarity
[*] Added a 'Controls' button on title screen
[*] Added Profile upgrade reminder if LV. points aren't being used
[/list]
Enjoy!
